title: The Critical Line and √X Mirrors
summary: The functional equation turns Re(s) = 1/2 into a mirror; the prime shadow and Landau's criterion turn zeros into growth; Stepanov's multiplicities, chains of about √X theta lifts, a flattened Harder–Narasimhan roof and Behrend's sphere close the net, ending on the Lean theorem riemannHypothesis.
